mapper.select: SELECT /* getReadingStatsSetting */ U.USER_NUMB , COALESCE(S.RSTA_YSNO, #{privateYsno}) AS PUBLIC_YSNO , U.USER_STAT FROM TM_USERXM U LEFT JOIN TM_USSETX S ON S.USER_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB WHERE U.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb}

SELECT /* getHeatmapRowList */ H.ROW_TYPE , H.READ_YEAR , H.READ_DATE , H.READ_SECS FROM ( SELECT #{rowTypeYear} AS ROW_TYPE , YEAR(Y.READ_DATE) AS READ_YEAR , NULL AS READ_DATE , 0 AS READ_SECS FROM TB_RDATDX Y WHERE Y.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} GROUP BY YEAR(Y.READ_DATE) UNION ALL SELECT #{rowTypeDaily} AS ROW_TYPE , YEAR(D.READ_DATE) AS READ_YEAR , D.READ_DATE , D.READ_SECS FROM TB_RDATDX D WHERE D.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND D.READ_DATE BETWEEN #{periodStart} AND #{periodEnd} ) H ORDER BY H.ROW_TYPE DESC , H.READ_YEAR DESC , H.READ_DATE

SELECT /* getTopBookTimeList */ MAX(R.REPT_NUMB) AS REPT_NUMB , R.BOOK_NUMB , B.BOOK_TITL , B.BOOK_ATHR , B.BOOK_CVIM , SUM(GREATEST(T.READ_SECS, 0)) AS READ_SECS FROM TM_RDTMRX T JOIN TM_REPORT R ON R.REPT_NUMB = T.REPT_NUMB AND R.USER_NUMB = T.USER_NUMB JOIN TM_BKINFO B ON B.BOOK_NUMB = R.BOOK_NUMB WHERE T.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND T.TMRX_STAT = #{completedStat} AND T.ENDX_DATE >= #{timerStart} AND T.ENDX_DATE < #{timerEnd} AND T.READ_SECS > 0 GROUP BY R.BOOK_NUMB , B.BOOK_TITL , B.BOOK_ATHR , B.BOOK_CVIM ORDER BY READ_SECS DESC , R.BOOK_NUMB DESC LIMIT 3

WITH POSITIVEDATE AS ( SELECT D.READ_DATE , TO_DAYS(D.READ_DATE) - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY D.READ_DATE) AS STREAK_GROUP FROM TB_RDATDX D WHERE D.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND D.READ_SECS > 0 AND D.READ_DATE <= #{today} ) , STREAKGROUP AS ( SELECT MAX(P.READ_DATE) AS END_DATE , COUNT(*) AS STREAK_DAYS FROM POSITIVEDATE P GROUP BY P.STREAK_GROUP ) , STREAKSUMMARY AS ( SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN S.END_DATE IN (#{today}, DATE_SUB(#{today}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) THEN S.STREAK_DAYS ELSE 0 END), 0) AS CURRENT_STREAK_DAYS , COALESCE(MAX(S.STREAK_DAYS), 0) AS LONGEST_STREAK_DAYS FROM STREAKGROUP S ) , TIMERCOMPARE AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN D.READ_DATE >= #{currentStart} AND D.READ_DATE < #{currentEnd} THEN GREATEST(D.READ_SECS, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS CURRENT_READ_SECS , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN D.READ_DATE >= #{previousStart} AND D.READ_DATE < #{previousEnd} THEN GREATEST(D.READ_SECS, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS PREVIOUS_READ_SECS , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN D.READ_DATE >= #{currentStart} AND D.READ_DATE < #{currentEnd} AND D.READ_SECS > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS CURRENT_READ_DAYS , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN D.READ_DATE >= #{previousStart} AND D.READ_DATE < #{previousEnd} AND D.READ_SECS > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS PREVIOUS_READ_DAYS FROM TB_RDATDX D WHERE D.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} ) , REPORTBASE AS ( SELECT R.REPT_STAT , R.REPT_ENDT , CASE WHEN R.REPT_GRDE REGEXP '^(0\\.5|[1-4](\\.0|\\.5)?|5(\\.0)?)$' THEN FLOOR(CAST(R.REPT_GRDE AS DECIMAL(2, 1))) ELSE NULL END AS RATING_VALUE FROM TM_REPORT R WHERE R.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} ) , REPORTSUMMARY AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN R.REPT_STAT = #{readStat} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS READ_COUNT , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN R.REPT_STAT = #{doneStat} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DONE_COUNT , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN R.REPT_STAT = #{stopStat} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS STOP_COUNT , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN R.RATING_VALUE = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS RATING_ZERO_COUNT , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN R.RATING_VALUE = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS RATING_ONE_COUNT , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN R.RATING_VALUE = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS RATING_TWO_COUNT , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN R.RATING_VALUE = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS RATING_THREE_COUNT , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN R.RATING_VALUE = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS RATING_FOUR_COUNT , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN R.RATING_VALUE = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS RATING_FIVE_COUNT , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN R.REPT_STAT = #{doneStat} AND R.REPT_ENDT >= DATE_FORMAT(#{currentStart}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND R.REPT_ENDT < DATE_FORMAT(#{currentEnd}, '%Y-%m-%d') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS CURRENT_DONE_BOOKS , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN R.REPT_STAT = #{doneStat} AND R.REPT_ENDT >= DATE_FORMAT(#{previousStart}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND R.REPT_ENDT < DATE_FORMAT(#{previousEnd}, '%Y-%m-%d') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS PREVIOUS_DONE_BOOKS FROM REPORTBASE R ) SELECT /* getStatsAggregate */ R.READ_COUNT , R.DONE_COUNT , R.STOP_COUNT , S.CURRENT_STREAK_DAYS , S.LONGEST_STREAK_DAYS , R.RATING_ZERO_COUNT , R.RATING_ONE_COUNT , R.RATING_TWO_COUNT , R.RATING_THREE_COUNT , R.RATING_FOUR_COUNT , R.RATING_FIVE_COUNT , T.CURRENT_READ_SECS , T.PREVIOUS_READ_SECS , T.CURRENT_READ_DAYS , T.PREVIOUS_READ_DAYS , R.CURRENT_DONE_BOOKS , R.PREVIOUS_DONE_BOOKS FROM REPORTSUMMARY R CROSS JOIN STREAKSUMMARY S CROSS JOIN TIMERCOMPARE T
